LanguageData.Gun_RPK-74_RWP.label: RPK-74
LanguageData.Gun_RPK-74_RWP.description: A Soviet-designed light machine gun, the RPK-74 is an evolution of the AK platform. It offers high firepower with its 5.45x39mm cartridge in a drum magazine, maintaining reliability and accuracy over sustained fire. Ideal for suppression and defending positions, but comes with increased weight.
